name: shiftleft-api-integration-task
description: Run a ShiftLeft test pack through the public API, wait for completion, enforce quality gates, and write JSON and JUnit XML for Azure Pipelines.
helpMarkDown: Configure your ShiftLeft **server URL**, **pack ID**, and API credentials. Store passwords in a **variable group** or secret pipeline variables—never commit them. Optional **tenant ID** when your deployment uses tenant-scoped API access. See the extension **Overview** on the Marketplace (or your organization’s extension details) for capabilities and a YAML example. Output variables: `shiftLeftExecutionId`, `shiftLeftTriggerExecutionId`, `shiftLeftDecision` (set a task `name` in YAML to reference them).
author: Total Shift Left

inputs.name: serverUrl
inputs.label: Server URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the ShiftLeft API (e.g. `https://app.example.com`). No trailing slash.

inputs.name: apiEmail
inputs.label: API email (login)
inputs.helpMarkDown: User email for `POST /api/v1/login`. Use `$(ShiftLeftEmail)` from a variable group to avoid storing in YAML.

inputs.name: apiPassword
inputs.label: API password
inputs.helpMarkDown: Password for login. Mark the pipeline variable as secret or use a secret variable group.

inputs.name: packId
inputs.label: Pack ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Test run pack identifier (`packId` from the API).

inputs.name: waitForCompletion
inputs.label: Wait for completion
inputs.helpMarkDown: If false, only triggers the run and exits successfully without polling.

inputs.name: pollIntervalSeconds
inputs.label: Poll interval (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Interval between status polls when waiting.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.label: Timeout (minutes)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum time to wait for a terminal status.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory for output files
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for JSON and XML result files (defaults to `$(Build.SourcesDirectory)`).

inputs.name: passThresholdPercent
inputs.label: Pass threshold (%)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minimum success rate percent. Use `0` to disable threshold and rely on status only.

inputs.name: failOnErrorTests
inputs.label: Fail on error tests
inputs.helpMarkDown: If true, any error-count > 0 fails the gate.

inputs.name: gateFailureResult
inputs.label: Gate failure as
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to treat quality-gate failures (maps to Jenkins FAILURE vs UNSTABLE).

inputs.name: writeJsonSummary
inputs.label: Write JSON summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Write a summary JSON file to the working directory.

inputs.name: jsonSummaryPath
inputs.label: JSON summary path (relative)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Relative path under the working directory.

inputs.name: writeTestResultsXml
inputs.label: Write XML test results
inputs.helpMarkDown: Write XML test results for use with **Publish Test Results** (`PublishTestResults@2`). Requires wait for completion and a finished run.

inputs.name: testResultsXmlPath
inputs.label: XML results path (relative)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Relative path under the working directory.

outputVariables.name: shiftLeftExecutionId
outputVariables.description: Execution ID from status/results (may differ from trigger response).

outputVariables.name: shiftLeftDecision
outputVariables.description: Quality gate decision code (e.g. PASSED, GATE_FAIL_THRESHOLD).

outputVariables.name: shiftLeftTriggerExecutionId
outputVariables.description: Execution ID returned from the trigger call.
